items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The interviewer asks 'You know Buster Moore?' and the interviewee does not respond with confirmation of personal acquaintance, only acknowledging the name in the flow of conversation.

ctx.x: What's his name? Freddie what? I don't know his last name. He's a pretty good tram man man. Yeah he played now. He played with Buster too. You know Buster the tram man. You know Buster Moore?
